doNow.prompt: A motor does work lifting a load. What happens to the energy?

choices.text: It is transferred to the load as gravitational potential energy, with some wasted as heat and sound.
It gets used up completely.
choices.misconception: Energy gets used up when work is done.

rationale.chose: The learner selected option It gets used up completely. as their answer to this question.
rationale.thinks: They are applying the coded wrong turn instead of checking what each part of the working represents.
rationale.reteach: Reteach with an energy transfer diagram showing the input energy equals the useful output plus the wasted transfer, so nothing is used up.
